state: Focused verification after confirmed concurrent-render availability repair; development only

adversarial_review.confirmed_issue: An uncommitted suspended B render changed a shared identity ref and prevented the still-committed A draft from accepting edits. This was an isolated concurrent-render availability defect, not demonstrated operational data leakage.
adversarial_review.repair: Draft scope and value use React state adjustment on key changes; stale setters compare snapshot scope identity. Dock parent only keys its child; child layout cleanup retires callbacks at commit/unmount. No identity refs are mutated during render.
